upload.matchDateHint: Used to cross this video's metrics with the player's GPS history in their profile. Without a date, the video won't appear in that comparison.

list.emptyDescription: Upload the first video to start the analysis.

delete.title: Delete "{{title}}"?
delete.description: This deletes the video, the analysis, the tracks, and the files in Storage. This can't be undone.

result.emptyPositionsDescription: Not enough positions were detected to draw the tactical board.
result.emptyTracksDescription: That video has no registered tracks.

editDialog.title: Edit video
editDialog.matchDateHint: Used to cross this video's metrics with the player's GPS history in their profile.

analyzeDialog.title: Choose the detection model
analyzeDialog.hint: Nano processes faster and is enough for standard, well-framed video. Small detects a lot more players and the ball (tested: 4x more player detections, 75x more ball detections) — worth it for harder shots (panning camera, high angle, vertical video), at the cost of ~30% more processing time.

insights.legacyTitle: This video has no analysis layers
insights.legacyDescription: It was processed before events and metrics existed. Re-analyze it (preferably with the Small model) to generate them.
insights.geometryDescription: The pitch could not be calibrated in this video, so everything in meters (width, depth, area, progression) comes from a fallback scale. Heatmaps, being relative positions, are less affected.
insights.noEventsFallback: There was not enough material to derive events.
insights.shapeSubtitle: Averaged over frames with the team visible
insights.noShapeFallback: Players could not be grouped into two teams by shirt color.
insights.noPlayerMetrics: No per-player metrics for this video yet.
insights.limitsSubtitle: Limits reported by the analysis itself
